system.description:
“The forest has teeth. And it is always hungry.” You are a terrifying predator who uses illusion and shadow to stalk your prey, shifting into a gaunt, monstrous form to deliver debilitating strikes before feasting upon the fallen.

LEVEL 3

Cursed Magic.

You know Shadow spells and Illusion spells. You can only know 3 Spell Schools.

Unending Hunger.

You gain a new Direbeast Form, The Hunger. All your Direbeast Forms now appear gaunt and emaciated. While Beastshifted, you gain Curse of Hunger: All your Direbeast Forms are considered Demons now. Your attacks have advantage against Frightened or Bloodied targets.

LEVEL 7

Bump in the Night.

When you make a melee attack while Unseen, it deals an extra 1d10 damage.

LEVEL 11

Curse of Bleeding.

When you hit a target with an attack while Beastshifted, they cannot regain HP, 1 turn. Targets can make a WIL save on their turn to remove this effect.

LEVEL 15

Feast of Flesh.

(1/encounter) When you kill a non-minion creature while Beastshifted, you feast upon it. You regain 2xLVL HP and 2 uses of your Beastshift feature. All enemies that see this must make a WIL save or be Frightened of you until they make a WIL save on their turn.

Direbeast Forms — The Hunger

The Hunger (Medium). Transform into a Medium Demon. Gain +DEX speed, Claws, Bite, Ritual Hunter. You have advantage to Hide. Claws. 1 Action, Damage: 2d4+DEX Slashing. On Crit: +LVL damage. Bite. 1 Action, Damage: 2d4+DEX Piercing. On crit: regain. Ritual Hunter. You can cast Illusion and Shadow spells while Beastshifted as The Hunger. You do not need to speak, use hand gestures, or have a free hand/spellcasting focus. Spells you cast are hidden until their effect occurs.

Chimeric Boons

Fearsome Presence. When you Beastshift, enemies in Burst 2 must make a WIL save or become Frightened of you until they make a WIL save on their turn. When a creature saves from this boon, they are immune to it for 24 hours.

Amorphous Hide. You can move through spaces as narrow as one foot wide without squeezing. (1/encounter) A critical hit of your choice against you becomes a normal hit instead.
